newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ANZ Bank says rates under review.
newsitem.headline: ANZ Bank says rates under review.

text.p: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd said on Wednesday thta it was reviewing its interest charges following the Reserve Bank of Australia's decision to lower official interest rates.
"All I can say at the moment is that we are reviewing our rates," a spokesman from the bank told Reuters.

The spokesman said it was possible the bank would make an announcement about rates later on Wednesday. The Reserve Bank earlier on Wednesday cut official rates by 0.5 percentage points to 5.0 percent, the fifth such cut in a year.
